references.phrase: direct sum of countably generated R-modules
references.context: Module theory: direct sums of countably generated modules over a ring

references.disposition: Both implications are part of the stated criterion; no replacement by countably presented or finitely generated modules is justified.

review_rationale: Examined the full projectivity equivalence, separating projective modules, flat modules, Mittag-Leffler modules and the direct-sum condition, without confusing countable generation with finite generation.
